author: Kusha N M
raw:
ದುರ್ಜನರು ಇಹರಿಂದು ಬುಧಜನರ ಸೋಗಿನಲಿ
ಅರ್ಜಿಸುವ ವಿದ್ಯೆಗಳ ಸಜ್ಜನರ ಮಣಿಸೆ
ವರ್ಜಿಸುತ ಮೈಮರೆವ ಹೊರಗೆಳೆಯೆ ಮುಖವಾಡ
ಗರ್ಜಿಸುವೆ ಜೀವನದಿ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Today the wicked go about disguised as the wise,
using their learning to bring good people down;
shake off your stupor, tear away their masks,
and you will roar through life, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Not everyone who looks learned is good; some use knowledge to harm. Stay alert, see through the masks, and you will stand strong.
